high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "apartment18.in." The post appears to be a sponsored advertisement for a set of three wall art pieces titled "Temple Gate Wall Art - Set of 3." The wall art features intricate designs inspired by temple architecture, with vibrant colors and detailed carvings of deities and architectural elements. The setting includes a modern living room with a green sofa adorned with beige and gray cushions. A small potted plant is placed on the left side of the sofa, adding a touch of greenery to the space.
